proof_body:
by
  intro R M N _ _ _ _ _ _ hT hD t
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [hx, hy, add_zero]
  | tmul m n =>
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hm⟩ := hT m
    obtain ⟨n', rfl⟩ := hD n r hr
    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', hm, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
target_source: ∀ (R M N : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R M] [Module R N], (∀ m : M, ∃ r : R, r ≠ 0 ∧ r • m = 0) → (∀ (n : N) (r : R), r ≠ 0 → ∃ n' : N, r • n' = n) → ∀ t : TensorProduct R M N, t = 0
